purpose: This table is a clean, deduplication-free lookup of the sixteen airline carriers that flew out of New York City airports in 2013, mapping each two-letter BTS carrier code to its full legal carrier name, intended to feed joins against flight-level fact tables keyed on carrier code.
usage: Join downstream flight records to this table on carrier to resolve a human-readable airline name; both carrier and name are fully populated (null_rate 0.0) and unique across all 16 rows, so no null-handling or deduplication logic is required by consumers.
limitations: The table covers only the 16 carriers observed in the 2013 NYC-origin flights dataset and will not resolve codes for carriers outside that set; all Airbyte capture metadata (raw id, extraction timestamp, meta blob) was dropped as non-business data and is unavailable for lineage debugging downstream.
